_comment: Pterodactyl egg for a FRUKT Multiplayer dedicated server (FruktServer, no game or Wine needed).
name: FRUKT Dedicated Server
author: phoenix557@users.noreply.github.com
description: A dedicated server for the FRUKT Multiplayer mod (github.com/Phoenix557). It runs no game, so it needs almost no CPU or memory; the players' games share the world. Players join with the server's IP and port, or find it in the MULTIPLAYER menu on their network.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
# FruktServer is inside the Docker image, so there is nothing to download.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Install finished. The server is in the image; just start it."

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list (up to 24 characters).

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map players load when they join: Yard, or any other FRUKT map name.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: How many players can join at once (1 to 16).
